message.content:
This editorial illustration is the cover of a magazine titled "TEMPO". The central figure is a caricatured man’s face, rendered in warm brown, orange, and red tones with deep shadows. He holds large, dark gray binoculars up to his eyes with both hands. The man’s mouth is slightly open, revealing white teeth with a metallic silver-gray object visible behind them. His hands, which grip the binoculars, show detailed lines and wrinkles.

Reflected in the circular glass lenses of the binoculars are two distinct rust-red silhouettes. The left lens shows a horizontal, jagged shape, while the right lens shows a more vertical, irregular shape.

The top of the cover features white text on a dark blue-gray background, including "Cara Amran Sulaiman Menguasai Sektor Pangan H.92" and "Kekerasan Seksual di Kampus Kita H.78". To the right, a white box contains a barcode, a QR code, and small text: "25 NOVEMBER-1 DESEMBER 2024", "RP 50.000", and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273". At the bottom left, bold black text reads "AWAS JOKOWI KEMBALI" above a paragraph of smaller black text. The man wears a light blue collared shirt at the bottom edge of the frame.
